# Vendored dependencies

`imgui-1.91.9b/` contains the unchanged upstream core headers, core source files, Win32/DX12 backends and MIT license needed by the build. Unused upstream examples and docs may exist in a developer checkout but are ignored by this repository.

Pinned source: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/tree/f5befd2d29e66809cd1110a152e375a7f1981f06

Font and compiler provenance are recorded in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
